Type: sofa
Name: Stone & Beam Carrigan Casual Sofa Chaise, 95"W, Navy
Colors: Navy
Materials: Cotton
Overall: 95"W x 39"D x 37"H; seat height: 22.5"H; seat depth: 28"D; seat back height: 32.5"H; arm height: 27"H; leg height: 3"H; chaise depth: 70.5"D; chaise width: 34.5"W Removable slipcover in 100% cotton fabric; fully padded solid-wood frame with mortise-and-tenon construction and 8-gauge sinuous spring support system Slipcover is removable for easy cleaning and refreshing. This item is made to order just for you.
